archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY + FESTIVE EDITORIAL HERITAGE (Vermilion, Ivory, Gold)
design_philosophy: Authored Kolkata festive cultural companion. A harmonious blend of traditional Bengali heritage aesthetics (alta red, kash flower white, brass lamps, shankha patterns) with precision navigational utility (metro proximity, Leaflet map markers, Haversine distance, 2-opt route planning). Avoids AI slop like generic purple gradients or sterile SaaS gray boxes.

theme_strategy.light_aesthetic: Warm Ivory paper base (#FAF7F2), vermilion headers and accents (#C8281E), molten antique gold trims (#C69214 / #E2B93B), deep charcoal typography (#1C1613).
theme_strategy.dark_aesthetic: Midnight Terracotta & Deep Obsidian base (#120F0D / #1B1512), soft warm gold highlights (#F1C40F), glowing crimson indicators (#E63946), ivory text (#FDFBF7).

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Subtle sacred grace. Gentle card hover lifts, smooth accordion expansions, responsive map pan-and-zoom.
motion_and_interactions.hover_transitions: transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.2s ease (Never use transition: all)
motion_and_interactions.map_markers: Custom pulsed SVG icon when pandal is active or selected in list
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) or use Tailwind 'motion-safe:' prefix

accessibility_and_wcag.contrast_ratio: All body and label typography strictly passes APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum on their respective backgrounds.
accessibility_and_wcag.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px touch targets on mobile for all map pins, filter chips, and action buttons.
accessibility_and_wcag.screen_readers: All icon-only buttons (like Save to Favourites heart or Close) MUST have descriptive aria-label attributes.
accessibility_and_wcag.honest_data_disclosure: When coordinates are approximate (e.g. 19 records without exact street snapping), display an honest 'Approximate Neighbourhood Anchor' tag with info tooltip.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Leaflet: Install leaflet and @types/leaflet via `yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet` in frontend directory. Import leaflet CSS in index.html or App.tsx.
2. Theme tokens: Update `frontend/src/index.css` with the festive Ivory, Vermilion, and Molten Gold palette in `:root` and `.dark` blocks, and import Playfair Display + Plus Jakarta Sans fonts.
3. Seed data: Ensure 286 Kolkata pandal records are loaded into MongoDB / fast-query API with coordinates, zone tags, nearest metro, Bengali titles, and verification status.
4. Geolocation & Haversine: Implement genuine Haversine distance calculator with 'straight-line distance' label. Support browser Geolocation with graceful denial state.
5. Route Optimizer: Provide 2-opt or nearest-neighbour TSP route ordering for multi-pandal itineraries, chunked into Google Maps URLs (up to 9 waypoints per link).
6. Storage: Use localStorage for favourite pandals ('pujopath_favourites') and saved itineraries.
7. All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes as specified.
